list.title: Stacks
list.emptyBody: A stack is a compose file that Bayplan deploys and keeps tidy. Its services, networks, secrets and configs go together, and nothing is left behind when you remove it.

create.title: Create a stack
create.body: Nothing is deployed until you review and deploy it.

name.label: Name
name.helper: Letters, numbers, dash or underscore. It can't change later.
name.helperSwarm: Letters, numbers, dash or underscore, up to 61 characters. It can't change later.
name.helperStandalone: Lowercase letters, numbers, dash or underscore, up to 255 characters. It can't change later.

create.success: Created stack {{name}}. Nothing is deployed yet.

errors.nameRequired: Enter a name for the stack.
errors.nameInvalid: Use only letters, numbers, dash and underscore, starting with a letter or number.
errors.nameInvalidSwarm: Use only letters, numbers, dash and underscore, starting with a letter or number, up to 61 characters.
errors.nameInvalidStandalone: Use only lowercase letters, numbers, dash and underscore, starting with a letter or number, up to 255 characters.
errors.nameTaken: A stack named {{name}} already exists on {{env}}.
errors.permission: You can't create stacks on this environment.
errors.generic: Couldn't create the stack. Check the connection and try again.
errors.lost: The server didn't answer. The stack may have been created: check the list before you try again.

error.body: Check the connection and try again.

gone.heading: This stack is gone
gone.body: It was removed. Go back to the list to find it.
